en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan Al-Saffār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Washā, from Aḥmad ibn ‘Ā`idh, from Abī Khadījah, who said:
I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) about the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.). He (the Imam (a.s.)) replied, “Verily it is the best of deeds.”
